title: A HELP history that opens on an indexation line counts it twice
found: finishOpenings takes the first stated balance as the opening, then help_indexation posts the same row again. The generator avoids it by printing a 'Balance brought forward' row, the shape a government page shows, so the world ties; the defect remains for any file that starts on 1 June.
want: The balance at 2026-06 is -10,280.00. Today it is -10,560.00.
